content_en.prompt: Kittu's little sister made rules for stacking building bricks, shown as arrows: start with any brick; always follow the arrows (choosing if several are available); an arrow back to the same brick means stacking another of the same kind; stop when no arrow leads away. Kittu stacks four different towers for her little sister.
content_en.question: Which of the four towers did Kittu build, following the rules made up by her little sister?
content_en.explanation: A wrongly jumps from two blue boxes to an orange cube (no such arrow). B wrongly stacks a green cylinder on another green cylinder (no such arrow). D wrongly jumps from green cylinder to orange cube (no such arrow). C correctly follows blue-blue-green-yellow pyramid, and correctly stops since no arrow leaves the pyramid.
content_en.ct_explanation: The topmost brick represents the current state; the rules define transitions between states — this is a state diagram. Since any brick can start, all are start states; the pyramid is the only accepting (finishing) state. This describes a nondeterministic finite automaton, widely used in computer science to model software behavior, language structures, and hardware interactions.

content_zh.prompt: Kittu的妹妹訂了一套堆積木的規則，用箭頭圖表示：可以從任何一塊積木開始；一定要照著箭頭走（如果有多個箭頭可以選一個）；如果箭頭指回同一塊積木，代表可以再疊一塊同款積木；如果沒有箭頭可以走了，就要停止堆疊。Kittu疊了四座不同的塔要送給妹妹。
content_zh.question: 依照妹妹訂的這套規則，下面哪一座塔才是Kittu疊出來的？
content_zh.explanation: 塔A從兩塊藍色箱子直接跳到橘色方塊，但規則裡沒有這個箭頭。塔B在綠色圓柱上又疊了一個綠色圓柱，但規則裡沒有這個箭頭。塔D從綠色圓柱跳到橘色方塊，規則裡也沒有這個箭頭。塔C依序是藍-藍-綠-黃色金字塔，完全符合規則，而且金字塔沒有箭頭可以再往下走，所以正確停止。
content_zh.ct_explanation: 最上面那塊積木代表「目前的狀態」，規則定義了狀態之間如何轉換——這就是所謂的「狀態圖」。因為任何積木都能當起點，所以每一塊都是起始狀態；黃色金字塔則是唯一的「結束狀態」。這描述的是一種「非決定性有限自動機」，在資訊科學裡廣泛用來模擬軟體行為、語言結構、硬體元件間的互動。
